class.name: IfcValve
class.brief_description: A valve is used in a building services piping distribution system to control or modulate the flow of the fluid. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcValve defines the occurrence of any valve; common information about valve types is handled by IfcValveType .
